messages:
olivia_ml: quick heads-up — planning a perf bring-up for harrier-8b (open checkpoint) focused on throughput/latency across ctx and batching, plus int8/int4 quant smoke. need to prioritize runs and list of checks.

ben_infra: +1. what are our target knobs and SLOs? also any special infra constraints (warmup, pinning, gpu type)?

tara_prod: SLOs we care about: p95 < 250ms for ctx<=512 at qps targets; steady throughput baseline for batch sizes 1/4/8. coldstart p95 < 800ms for first request after deploy.

paul_research: plan proposal: ctx sweep [64,128,512,2048], batch sweep [1,4,8,16], quant variants [fp16, int8, int4]. run warm vs cold experiments. run 10 warmup prompts then record. quality smoke: run evaluation promptset (50) to detect regressions vs reference.

olivia_ml: sounds good. priority order: 1) baseline fp16 batch/ctx for latency, 2) int8 throughput profile, 3) int4 quick quality check, 4) coldstart probe and KV warmup impact.

ben_infra: infra notes — use p4d-24g for baseline, run with continuous-batching disabled for single-request SLOs. enable kernel autotune for int8. we should pin model to a single node for isolation.

paul_research: benchmark command I'm pushing to bench harness:

```bash
python bench/run.py --model harrier-8b --device gpu --dtype fp16 --batches 1,4,8,16 --ctx 64,128,512,2048 --warmup 10 --log-level info --out results/harrier8b_fp16.json
```

olivia_ml: add quant flag for int8/int4 for those runs: `--quant int8` etc. also include `--prefix-cache-off` to measure coldstart.

ben_infra: suggestion: include KV probe flow to measure warm cache latency: run a 1-token prefix with known cache keys to populate KV, then one full request. compare to no-probe case.

paul_research: example log snippet we saw in earlier run (simulated):

```
[2026-02-14 12:03:21] INFO run: batch=1 ctx=512 dtype=fp16 p50=95ms p95=220ms throughput=48 tok/s
[2026-02-14 12:05:01] INFO run: batch=8 ctx=64 dtype=int8 p50=30ms p95=110ms throughput=320 tok/s
[2026-02-14 12:07:10] WARN quality: int4 top-1 answer mismatch count=7/50 -> flag for eval
```

tara_prod: good to have that example. action items: olivia create benchmark matrix + run schedule; paul run initial fp16 and int8 baseline this week; ben implement KV probe and ensure node pinning; benchbot schedule nightly runs for longer ctx.

olivia_ml: created a simple matrix in the repo and kicking off baseline fp16 now. will post results link. thanks. :thumbsup:

benchbot: scheduled job `harrier8b-nightly-baseline` queued on p4d-24g for 2026-02-15T03:00Z. logs will appear in CI and results/harrier8b/*.json

deploy-bot: note: rolling canary to dedicated pool tomorrow at 06:00Z, will run canary traffic at 1% for 30m. monitor latency alerts.

ben_infra: final note — when running int4, include a quality metric threshold that auto-fails the run if eval accuracy drops >3% relative to fp16. prevents noisy int4 rollouts.

olivia_ml: agreed. I'll add thresholds and a small summary artifact with p50/p95/throughput + quality delta. posting link once first batch completes.

paul_research: thanks team — will follow up with a short doc summarizing findings and any recommended quant profiles if int8 meets targets.
